races.title: Bet On-Course With Star Sports Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KLIC BOUM made a promising start in this sphere after an absence when taking second late on at Newton Abbot and with this return to a longer distance also a plus he looks the way to go. Sweet Caryline should also take a step forward from an encouraging chasing debut fourth at Worcester and can give the selection most to do. KLIC BOUM (FR) SWEET CARYLINE BREEZETHROUGHLIFE (IRE)

races.title: starsportsbet.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: CREST OF ARMS is by far the least exposed of the quintet, and he's fancied to make a winning handicap debut for an in-form yard.
